one_line: Personal web app on the iPhone home screen: Shlokas (learn stanza by stanza from a PDF and a recording), House (sell-price calculator) and What-if (stay vs move).
verdict: Not today on the iPhone: the two calculators could be rebuilt on Linux and the web now, but Shlokas needs sound, which omxcode can't play on any platform yet, and the iPhone host has never run on a phone.

features.feature: Installs to the iPhone home screen (manifest, apple meta tags, icon, standalone)
features.omx_piece: none (web host serves no manifest); native UIKit app instead
features.evidence: mojoui/hosts/web.py has no web manifest or apple-mobile-web-app tags; UIKit build signs but never ran on a phone (docs/components.md header)
features.gap: Web host emits a manifest, icons and apple meta from App metadata; or a signed UIKit build run on the owner's iPhone

features.feature: Tab bar: bottom bar on the phone, top islands on the computer, sliding thumb
features.evidence: docs/components.md Tabs ✅ GTK/web/Android; uikit.mojo:451 draws TABS as a UISegmentedControl, not a UITabBar
features.gap: TabBar shell piece: bottom bar under compact width (UITabBar on iPhone), top pill on wide screens, spring thumb

features.feature: Auto / Light / Dark button, remembered, follows the phone, no white flash
features.evidence: docs/components.md 'Light and dark from the system' ✅ GTK/web, ❌ iPhone/Android
features.gap: UIKit traitCollection change → App.appearance; a per-app override setting

features.feature: Remembers small settings (last tab, repeats, speed) across launches
features.evidence: docs/components.md SQLite ✅ GTK/web, ❌ iPhone/Android
features.gap: mojoui.prefs: a tiny per-app key-value store (file / localStorage / NSUserDefaults / SharedPreferences)

features.feature: Deep links open a stanza (#/s/<id>/practise/<n>), back button works
features.evidence: tests/test_route.mojo; docs/components.md Route ✅ GTK/web, ❌ iPhone/Android
features.gap: Route on UIKit and Android (URL schemes / universal links into the same messages)

features.gap: Sheet component: UISheetPresentationController with detents on iPhone, a bottom sheet that drags to dismiss on web/GTK/Android, Liquid settle

features.feature: Sliders a finger can tap or drag anywhere on the band (not just the thumb)

features.gap: Slider(track_taps=True): a tap or drag on the track moves the thumb on every host

features.feature: Passcode gate online (one sign-in page, 400-day cookie, lockout after 10 tries)
features.evidence: mojoui/hosts/web.py has no sign-in or session cookie gate
features.gap: Web host auth hook (passcode or fh-saas sign-in in front of every session)

features.feature: Saves each app's state to SQLite a moment after the last change; survives restart

features.gap: mojoui.sqlite and Timers on UIKit (libsqlite3 ships with iOS; NSTimer)

features.feature: Same data on the phone and the computer (mark on the Mac, practise on the phone)
features.omx_piece: Web host sessions over one server database; mojoui.http for a native client
features.evidence: web host runs the app server-side per session (web.py:1732 /e/{sid}); docs/components.md HTTP ✅ GTK/web, ❌ iPhone/Android
features.gap: HTTP on UIKit (NSURLSession) so a native phone app syncs with the server

features.feature: Runs online away from home Wi-Fi (Railway, a /data volume)
features.evidence: never deployed or checked over a real network; every tap and slider move is a server round-trip (web.py header: HTMX posts events, canvas frames streamed as JPEG)
